benchmark.name: PPatHF Vim->Neovim test set (Pan et al., ISSTA'24)
benchmark.case_list: cases.txt (written next to this file by freeze.py; every run asserts it)

stored.note: read-only; nothing under ppathf-replication or ppathf-memory is written

erratum.note: ERRATUM-truncation.md: a stored baseline record is flagged when chars per input token > 4.5 (C) or it timed out; flagged cases are reported, never dropped silently

backend.request_limit: rcap.backend_ollama.GenerationLimits defaults: num_ctx * 2.6 chars for C = 42598; prompt + expected answer must fit the window; output budget 1.5 x expected answer

compile.tree_note: a COPY of ppathf-memory/nvim-build (Neovim 27fb62988e, one configured build); the copy is edited and restored, the original is never touched
compile.gate: a case is reachable only if the developer's own function compiles in this tree

rcap_reduced.protection: changed source lines only (Program-Reduction-Only: the benchmark has no SAP evidence)
rcap_reduced.target_rule: only segments the source side also removes; none when the source removes none

ctx_C.repair: rcap-reprompt-v3-context (missing names: Vim definition / Neovim equivalents)

scoring.metrics: rcap.ppathf_metrics (PPatHF package: tree-sitter C leaf tokens, comments dropped; token equality; token Levenshtein; RED = gen/src, src==0 -> /1)
scoring.protocol: aligned: a missing or incomplete output is scored as the pre-patch function (Origin)
